research_mode: official Ministry of Justice accredited statistics; fail-closed limitations; no parcel score, candidate value or business result

sources.name: Cautioning rate
verified_claims: The overall cautioning rate was about 8%, a series low.
limitations: The rate excludes motoring offences and is not a parcel risk rate.

sources.name: Defendants proceeded against
verified_claims: 1.36 million defendants were proceeded against at magistrates' courts in 2025.
limitations: Court case counts are not incident counts for an exact location.

sources.name: Summary motoring prosecutions
verified_claims: Summary motoring prosecutions increased by 5% to 803,000, a series high.
limitations: Enforcement and processing volumes do not establish parcel road safety.

sources.name: Sexual-offence prosecutions
verified_claims: Sexual-offence prosecutions increased by 18%, about 2,400 cases.
limitations: National court-flow change cannot be assigned to an address.

sources.name: Public-order prosecutions
verified_claims: Public-order prosecutions increased by 18%, about 3,500 cases.
limitations: Court-flow change is not local incident prevalence.

sources.name: Drug prosecutions
verified_claims: Drug-offence prosecutions increased by 13%, about 6,000 cases.
limitations: National prosecution growth cannot be used as parcel evidence.

sources.name: Fraud prosecutions
verified_claims: Fraud prosecutions increased by 13%, about 600 cases.
limitations: Fraud prosecution counts have no direct parcel attribution.

sources.name: Offenders convicted
limitations: Conviction timing can lag prosecution and does not identify parcel conditions.

sources.name: Indictable convictions
verified_claims: Indictable convictions increased by 8% from 217,200 to 234,200.
limitations: The annual court outcome is not a property-level risk indicator.

sources.name: Theft convictions
verified_claims: Theft convictions increased by 12%, by more than 7,000 defendants.
limitations: A national conviction increase cannot establish theft exposure at a parcel.
